paragrafos: **Three measurements side by side, never added together.** The prediction market (Polymarket and Kalshi), voting-intention polls checked against the official notice filed with the Commission des sondages, and French press coverage. The first round is on April 18 and the runoff on May 2, 2027.

**On 11/08/2026, the market and the polls measure different things about Marine Le Pen.** The polls put her first in all 60 first-round lists of the past 45 days and ahead in all 28 runoff matchups in which she was tested. The market pays close to 45 points for her victory. A separate contract, on whether she will be on the ballot, trades close to 90; her appeal to the Cour de cassation over her ineligibility is due to be ruled on by early April.

**What this screen does not do.** It does not add the two markets together, it does not turn a price into a voting intention, and it does not show a poll number without its checked official notice. On the Saturday and Sunday of each round, polls and prices are frozen, as French law of 1977 requires.
